topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: I can't help but think about the chance encounter we had, just after I found out we live in the same city. It's strange how things work out sometimes. We talked for a while, about the usual things, but it felt different, more personal. I kept wondering if I should have mentioned it sooner, the fact that we were so close, literally and figuratively. Now, every message feels loaded, and I find myself overthinking every word. I hope it doesn't come across in our conversations, or maybe it does, and I'm just not noticing. I just want things to be normal, whatever that means now.
